To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we introduce an efficient joint segmentation, occlusion labeling, stereo and flow estimation framework, 2) we introduce a novel slanted plane model, 3) we introduce an optimization algorithm that is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art approaches, and 4) we show superior performance on the challenging KITTI benchmarks.

(1) a novel slanted plane model allows for joint segmentation, stereo and occlusion boundary estimation from two stereo images, (2) the resulting model is solved efficiently using a novel, robust optimization algorithm, (3) the resulting approach is faster than competing approaches and (4) achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI benchmarks.

(1) a slanted plane objective for joint image segmentation, depth and boundary labeling can be optimized efficiently and (2) the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art results in the KITTI stereo and flow benchmarks.
